name: lead_confirmation
description: Result of the lead confirmation call: which ASMR service the visitor wants, or why we could not confirm one.

outcome.description: confirmed = the person named the service they need. unsure = they spoke with us but could not pick a service. wants_callback = they asked to be called later or reached by a person. do_not_call = they asked not to be called. wrong_number = the person is not the one who filled in the form.

confirmed_service.description: The one main service the person wants. Null unless outcome is confirmed. Use Other if their need fits none of the four named services.

callback_time.description: When the person said we may call back, in their own words. Null unless outcome is wants_callback.

notes.description: One or two short sentences about what the person needs, in English. No personal data beyond what they said about their request.
